const saved = [];
async function save(item) {
	saved.push(item);
}
async function run(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) {
		switch (items[i]) {
			case "a":
				await save(items[i]);
				break;
			default:
				await save(items[i]);
				break;
		}
	}
}
run(["a", "b", "c"]).then(() => {
	if (saved.join(",") !== "a,b,c") throw Error(String(saved));
	console.log(JSON.stringify({ saved }));
});
